//: Everything runs under Deno because the coordinator needs a GPU and Node has no WebGPU. The dependencies are still npm packages installed by `npm install`, so nodeModulesDir is 'manual': Deno resolves express/ws/node-datachannel out of node_modules rather than fetching its own copies. The import map lets kernels/*.ts reach @huggingface/gguf by its bare name from any directory.
//fmt: fmt and lint are scoped to kernels/, the TypeScript engine, which is the code Deno owns end to end. server/, web/, tools/ and test/ are Node-style JavaScript ({a, b} braces, single quotes) that deno fmt has no option to accept without rewriting every file; they are checked by `node --check` and tools/check_html.mjs instead (`npm run check`). Widen `include` when a directory is brought over to this style. fmt covers only the .ts and .mjs sources: kernels/README.md is a hand-written document whose tables deno fmt would re-pad on every edit for no gain. The .cache and .ref directories hold downloaded weights and are never source.
